page.overview:
What is Aramanli?

Aramanli was a location, possibly a planet.

It was given to Count Iason Atreides by Emperor Audrii I in 635 AG, and House Atreides/DE had been Counts of Aramanli.

It remained the main Atreides fief, until usurper Feyd I branded the House members as traitors and Baron Andreas von Wikkheizer received the fief.
